payload.name: Broaden date-specific search after exact-date miss
payload.description: When a question asks about an event on a specific date and a date-filtered search returns no match, run one broader search without the exact date filter before answering 'No information available'.
content: When a question includes an explicit date but the first search (especially with a point-in-time filter) returns no matching memory, run a follow-up hybrid search that omits the restrictive date filter or uses a wide window (±7 days), using the question's subject plus event terms such as 'accepted', 'achievement', 'internship', or the relevant noun from the question.

Do not require the memory's world_start to equal the question date; the question date may refer to when the event was discussed. If the follow-up finds a memory matching the subject and event type, answer from it.
Stop after this single broadened search if no relevant memory is found; do not keep expanding to unrelated dates, topics, or subjects.

solves: This solves cases where a question specifies an event date but the relevant memory records a different date (e.g., the question uses the date the event was discussed rather than the event's start date), and an exact-date filtered search misses the memory. It adds a controlled broadening step to find such memories before concluding no information.
